selected_wheel_metadata_license.scope: NVIDIA distribution metadata for the selected subset candidate.

selected_wheel_embedded_notice.scope: The selected wheel contains the NVIDIA CUDA SDK EULA text also preserved as NVIDIA-CUDA-12.9-License.txt in the TorchVision supplement; it is a distinct text from the NVSHMEM-specific source License.txt below.

source_license_distribution_scope.text: NVSHMEM supplement Section 2 explicitly identifies any portion of the SDK as distributable under the Agreement. The base distribution requirements apply: the app must have material additional functionality, SDK portions are accessed only through the app, and app terms must be consistent with the Agreement and protect user privacy/security/legal rights. The source license also restricts the NVSHMEM SDK to developing applications for systems with NVIDIA GPUs. This is an exact-scope summary; no legal conflict is inferred.

scope_reconciliation: The selected wheel metadata describes NVIDIA-distributed binary terms; its embedded License.txt is a general CUDA SDK EULA. The exact NVSHMEM source License.txt contains the NVSHMEM-specific supplement and additional third-party notices. These are distinct, complementary documents, not contradictory license texts. The source supplement expressly covers distribution of any SDK portion subject to its listed conditions.
